Inputs:
• 7 new branches were opened in
2022 across the Group bringing
the total to 134.
• 9 Digital Lobbies.
• 155 ATMs.
• Tier III Data Centre in Kenya.
• Investments in digital technology
and skills of Shs 1.3 billion in
East Africa to drive the digital
transformation agenda.
• Partnerships with fintechs to
provide innovative digital products
and customer value propositions.
Outputs:
• Customer numbers grew to
876,990, a 54% growth.
• 72 million mobile transactions
conducted representing 89% of all
customer transactions compared
to 52 million (86%) transactions
in 2021.
• 24/7/365 service availability
through our digital channels with
99% of core IT systems uptime
across the Group.
• Continued growth in revenue
streams through revamped digital
products and platforms.

merchants in 2021 to 2,180 in
2022.

Vodacom to launch Mgodi,
a mobile loans and savings
product. This contributed to a
127% increase in DTB Tanzania’s
customer base to 354,674.

grew by 15%.

9.5 billion.

billion from Shs 40 billion in 2021.
